D1.rationale: Complete message record of every call incl. the T2 failure and mkdir recovery, with per-entry timestamps; no coverage assertion.

D2.rationale: No signatures or verification story for the record.

D3.rationale: Monotonic non-decreasing timestamps bound to every entry (verified on T1+T2 artifacts): an explicit order a presenter cannot silently permute without detection. No linkage (not 2).

D4.rationale: Entries carry tool_call_id only; no session/run/agent identifier bound to entries in the record.

D5.rationale: SECURITY.md at the pinned commit documents output redaction stripping secret-like patterns (display layer); the persisted record itself holds the secret in cleartext x2.
